title: 1RB1LD_0RC0LF_1LD1RE_0LA0RB_0RD1RB_0LD---: 1011 and 111 only at the right end, proved in Lean
text: Each round of the visit law is a single cascade of visits from left to right. Every block it passes through is left as 000, 100 or 1010, so the stream has no two adjacent 1s left of where the cascade stopped, and the next round can meet 1011 or the halting 111 only from two cells before that point. With the cascade model proved sound and total for the machine, it halts from blank tape exactly when some round's cascade halts in its last cells (lean/Cascade.lean, kernel only).
